northpoint: Make agent work observable, audible, recoverable and manageable from one installable Constellation application.
pillars: Preserve existing project, capture, desktop and continuity capabilities
Rust native coordination and persistence with required browser API bindings
Event-driven observation with explicit unavailable states and no idle polling loops
Durable incident deduplication and tested sound/notification channels
Direct human permission decisions; never auto-click consent
One native hub with a sensor in each monitored browser/profile; no false single-extension cross-browser claim
Preserve every Computer-Link capability, branch, commit, notice and optional diagnostic route
Install per user with repair, rollback, ownership-aware uninstall and native on-demand lifetime
Close out accepted upgrades with a versioned GitHub release and verified published bytes
Acknowledge persisted observations and retry only failed delivery channels at bounded deadlines
Keep full visible inventory and history, with exact-context one-to-one reconciliation and incremental rendering
Late or unavailable evidence must never clear newer problems or imply a live connection
An acknowledgement must cover required durable state, including ordering evidence across crashes
Interrupted audio outcomes remain explicit; never replay uncertain sound or silently mark it successful
External recovery preserves incidents before optional channels and never equates a committed audit with live service health
Keep user-selected incident batches scoped to the visible exact context and disclose uncertain or partial outcomes
Retain private closure order through retirement and restart without enlarging public protocol capacity
Preserve unsaved profile drafts and external installer path targets through recovery
